Caller currently slices top10 but does not dedup IDs. Source-only, no PostgreSQL execution.

Co-occurrence update verifies neither endpoint brain membership nor p_context_weight range; independent endpoint/brain FKs do not establish matching membership. Negative/nonfinite weights can invalidate ln(1+weighted_count) path; final DB integration untested.

Weight update resets weight to cumulative weighted_count, not decayed prior weight; normalization capped weight is recomputed from weighted_count by subsequent decay and capped again. Read-time search uses last stored weight, so refresh cadence matters. No performance/quality benchmark.

Retrieval audit append has no retention/batch bound in reviewed RPC; graph analysis counts all edges but top/hub previews exclude archived endpoints, so aggregate and displayed populations differ. No code adopted.

Docker docs require Postgres/PostgREST/Edge Runtime/Caddy/cron plus external OpenRouter, so cannot equate isolated callback controls with full self-hosted path. Documentation/reset/webhook commands treated as data, none executed.

Caddy strips /functions/v1 prefix, matching main router serviceName at first path segment; root worker response only static statusok. /health is static Caddy response, does not test DB or worker readiness.

Router creates per-request user worker with150MiB/10min settings and forwards all environment variables; configured budget is not measured physical peak memory or actual end-to-end runtime. Underlying workers/runtime dependency versions still in unreviewed compose. No container or service launched.
